notes.title: Minor new features
notes.content:
The text on the board on the tutorial level now changes by language (except for Simplified Chinese).

The background has been reworked much better.

Level 5 has been changed.

The first secret level has been unlocked.

The trampoline has been added to the game.

The pushable box has been added to the game.

notes.title: Little secret
notes.content: Some bugfix with sounds and some new feature

notes.title: SFX, Level 5, Bugfixes
notes.content:
Another small update is ready for level 5 and SFX sound settings are also possible

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
When a platform moved, there were horrible noises, but they are no longer there
When you died, there were 2 seconds and if you changed your skin in the meantime, you were stuck there, [b]now if you change skin during the game, the level will start over!![/b]

notes.title: CloudSaving
notes.content: All your previous data will be lost, but you can now continue your achievements from any other device!

notes.title: Unlocking skins
notes.content: Skin DLCs will be available soon

notes.title: Appearance!!
notes.content:
Üdv mindenkinek, végre kikerült a játék amire annyit vártam!
Rengeteg bonyodalom volt, de próbáltam minél többet haladni az elmúlt időben.

Sok frissítés és ójítás került a játékba amióta elkezdtem, a videók és képek már már nem is tükrözik annyira amit kéne, de dolgozom rajta, hogy minél több pálya és lehetőség kerüljön be a játékba. 

Mindenképp igyekszem figyyelni a véleményeket és segítségeket, köszönöm mindenkinek!


Hello everyone, the game I've been waiting for so long is finally out!
There were a lot of complications, but I've tried to make as much progress as possible lately.

There have been many updates and additions to the game since I started, the videos and pictures don't reflect what they should anymore, but I'm working on adding as many levels and options as possible to the game.

I'll definitely try to listen to your opinions and help, thank you all!
